descriptionByLocale.en:
To strengthen our team at the Vista locations in Binningen and Sissach, we are looking for a qualified, initiative personality as Orthoptist/in 60 - 80% The Vista Eye Praxes & Clinics are the largest provider of eye medicine in Switzerland with their around 35 locations and about 500 employees. We offer first-class medical services for our patients and set standards in the disciplines of ophthalmology, eye surgery and eye laser medicine. Binningen and Sissach Your Tasks
• Continuous Conduct of Orthoptic (strabological) Investigations
• Leading your own speaking time (sewing school)
• The independent conduction of targeted preliminary studies (autorefraktometers, fields of view, OCT, biometry, corneal topography, endothelial cell measurements, etc.)
• Subjective refractions in children and adults A successfully completed training to/from the Orthoptist/in
• Embossed service awareness and readiness
• Self-responsibility, initiative and joy to work with patients of all ages
• The desire to get to know and develop new ones
• Knowledge of IT users, very good knowledge of German, more language skills We offer you
• Cooperation in an established team
• Competent support in the integration in the assigned work areas
• Conditions of employment with further training
• Regular working hours without night and weekend service
• The opportunity to regularly participate in training The location
